name: Canned Food
effect: Add 1 food to colony supply or restore 1 wound.

name: Dried Goods
effect: Add 1 food to colony supply.

name: Water Bottle
effect: Add 1 food to colony supply. May also clear a frostbite wound.

name: Fresh Produce
effect: Add 2 food to colony supply. Spoils if not used this round.

name: Army Rations
effect: Add 1 food to colony supply. Counts as 2 food for crisis.

name: Bandage
effect: Clear 1 wound from any survivor at the same location.

name: Antibiotics
effect: Clear 2 wounds from any survivor at the same location.

name: Painkiller
effect: Target survivor ignores wound penalties for 1 round.

name: First Aid Kit
effect: Clear all wounds from any one survivor. One-time use.

name: Vaccine
effect: Prevent a frostbite wound this round for all survivors at your location.

name: Pistol
effect: Kill 1 zombie. May be used in any location.

name: Rifle
effect: Kill 2 zombies. Requires 2+ action die value.

name: Shotgun
effect: Kill all zombies at one location (max 3).

name: Baseball Bat
effect: Kill 1 zombie. Does not cost an additional action die on a hit.

name: Knife
effect: Kill 1 zombie without rolling. Always succeeds but takes a wound on 1-2.

name: Fire Axe
effect: Kill 2 zombies. May also remove 1 barricade at the current location.

name: Crowbar
effect: Build a barricade without spending an additional action die.

name: Hammer
effect: Build a barricade. Barricades built with this tool hold for 2 hits.

name: Rope
effect: Move a survivor across two locations for the cost of one movement action.

name: Binoculars
effect: Once per round, scout any location — reveal number of zombies and items.

name: Radio
effect: Communicate secretly with any player — exchange one card without being seen.

name: Shovel
effect: Remove 2 zombies from a location (they return to spawn pool).

name: Gas Can
effect: Required for vehicle actions. May also be used to start a fire (+2 morale, summons 2 zombies).

name: Lighter
effect: Start a small fire. Kill 1 zombie, or add 1 to crisis fuel contribution.

name: Propane Tank
effect: Kill up to 3 zombies at a location. Single use; explosive.

name: Scrap Metal
effect: Trade for 1 of any non-weapon item at the colony.

name: Old Cloth
effect: May be used as a bandage (clear 1 wound) in a pinch.

name: Batteries
effect: Power a radio or binoculars for one extra use this round.

name: Old Book
effect: No effect. Discard for 1 influence.

name: Compass
effect: Reduce movement die cost by 1 this round.
